entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return for the VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order was delivered on January 12th. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
I just decided against it. I want my money back.

I see. Well, I do need to inform you that for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, we have a 10-day return window. That policy is in place for hygiene reasons and because the device activation links the hardware to a user account. It looks like today is the 13th day since you received it, which puts it just outside that period.
Of course it is. Just wonderful.

I understand the timing is frustrating. The policy is usually firm, but we can make exceptions for extenuating circumstances. Was there a specific reason that prevented you from contacting us within the first 10 days?
You could say that. I've had other priorities besides returning your wristband.
I understand completely. Could you elaborate just a bit? It would help me authorize an exception if one applies.
Fine. My husband, who is active military, had a medical emergency right before his deployment. He was in the hospital and had to have unexpected surgery. So, no, I didn't have time to call.

Oh, I am very sorry to hear that. I hope he is recovering well. Thank you for sharing that with me. A family medical emergency, especially involving a hospital stay and surgery, absolutely qualifies for an exception. I really appreciate your husband's service, and dealing with that right before a deployment sounds incredibly stressful.
It was.

I'm making a note on your account and approving a one-time exception right now. I can process a full refund for you. I'll email a prepaid return label to you immediately. Once our warehouse receives the item, you'll see the refund post to your account within 3-5 business days. How does that sound?
That's acceptable. Thank you.
You're very welcome. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything.
Alright. Again, I wish your husband a swift recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
